name: mscse-4plus1-gr-row-admitted-after-bachelors
description: A 4+1 MSCSE student (bachelor's Spring 2026) who entered an Integrated-program admission of Fall 2026 — after the bachelor's — while the Notre Dame transcript registers CSE 60641 (Fall 2025) at the graduate level, i.e. moved from UG to GR, which the Graduate School approves only before the bachelor's is awarded. A row registered UG is still refused (scenario mscse-4plus1-admitted-after-bachelors).
